title: Kestrel Bay Tidal Array Begins Supplying Power to Port Elsby
key_points: The array has a total capacity of 18 megawatts.
At typical output it will supply enough electricity for about 9,000 homes.
Construction took 26 months, four more than the 22 months planned, after storms delayed the subsea cable.
The project cost 64 million pounds, about a third of it from a national clean-energy fund.
A proposed second phase would add turbines further out in the bay, finished by 2029.
abstract: The Kestrel Bay Tidal Array, built by Marrowfield Energy and run with the Elsby Harbour Authority, has begun supplying predictable tidal power to Port Elsby.
